::: {#hero-heading}
Hi there! My name is Zengtao Wang and I am a pharmacometrician working at Eli Lilly and Company. I am a PKPD scientist by training and I am passionate about applying quantitative modeling and simulation to drug development.

## Education

**University of Minnesota, Twin Cities** \| Minneapolis, MN

PhD in Pharmaceutics \| Sept 2019 - May 2024

**Shanghai Jiao Tong University** \| Shanghai, China

B.S in Pharmacy \| Sept 2015 - June 2019

## Experience

**Eli Lilly and Company** \| Indianapolis, IN

Sr. Advisor - Pharmacometrician \| Sept 2026 - present

## Current Focus

I lead pharmacometrics support for neuroscience and diabetes clinical development, applying model-informed drug development to study design, simulation, and regulatory decisions. I also build workflow-automation tools and explore AI-augmented approaches for pharmacometrics.

## Expertise

- Population PK/PD, nonlinear mixed-effects modeling, model-based meta-analysis, time-to-event modeling, and quantitative systems pharmacology
- Clinical trial simulation and model-informed drug development
- NONMEM, Monolix, MATLAB/SimBiology, R, mrgsolve, Phoenix WinNonlin, SAAM II, and Stella Architect
:::
